# Lakhdatar Green Energy
> Leading industrial biomass pellet manufacturer in India producing high-GCV (3,800–4,200+ kcal/kg) biomass pellets engineered for coal replacement and thermal power plant co-firing compliance. Based in Tilda, Chhattisgarh, India.

## Company Overview
- **Legal Name**: Lakhdatar Green Energy
- **Headquarters & Manufacturing Plant**: Industrial Area, Tilda, District Raipur, Chhattisgarh 493114, India
- **Coordinates**: Latitude 21.5270° N, Longitude 81.7787° E
- **Founding Year**: 2025
- **Founder & Managing Director**: Sahil Nihichalani
- **Contact Numbers**: +91 74770 76500 / +91 88188 86500
- **Email**: sales@lakhdatargreenenergy.com / info@lakhdatargreenenergy.com
- **Website**: https://lakhdatargreenenergy.com

## Key Specifications & Performance Metrics
- **Gross Calorific Value (GCV)**: 3,800 – 4,200+ kcal/kg
- **Ash Content**: < 10% (minimal boiler slagging and clinker formation)
- **Moisture Content**: < 10% (optimum combustion efficiency)
- **Pellet Diameter**: 6mm to 8mm
- **Bulk Density**: > 650 kg/m³
- **Coal Displacement Capability**: Up to 97% direct coal replacement in adapted boilers; 5–10% seamless co-firing in pulverized coal thermal plants without equipment modifications
- **Track Record**: 20,000+ metric tonnes delivered across 80+ industrial boiler installations
- **Raw Material**: 100% surplus agricultural residue (mustard stalk, paddy straw, sawdust, agro-waste) directly aggregated from Central Indian farming communities

## Technical Knowledge Center & Whitepapers
- [Understanding High-GCV Biomass Pellets](https://lakhdatargreenenergy.com/resources/knowledge-center/high-gcv-biomass-pellets-guide.html): Guide to calorific values, combustion chemistry, and bulk density.
- [Biomass Pellet Composition & Laboratory Testing](https://lakhdatargreenenergy.com/resources/knowledge-center/biomass-pellet-composition-testing-protocols.html): Laboratory protocols for testing GCV, proximate/ultimate analysis, and ash fusion temperatures.
- [Carbon Neutrality of Biomass vs Coal](https://lakhdatargreenenergy.com/resources/knowledge-center/carbon-neutrality-of-biomass-vs-coal.html): Scope 1 emission mathematics and lifecycle carbon analysis.
- [Indian Biomass Fuel Standards (BIS/CEA/MoP)](https://lakhdatargreenenergy.com/resources/knowledge-center/navigating-indian-biomass-fuel-quality-procurement-standards.html): Procurement standards for Indian thermal power utilities and compliance mandates.
- [Biomass Economics & LCOE Transition](https://lakhdatargreenenergy.com/resources/whitepapers/biomass-economics-lcoe-coal-to-pellet-transition.html): Detailed economic models of fuel cost savings and levelized cost of energy.
- [Decarbonizing Industrial Heat 2026 Outlook](https://lakhdatargreenenergy.com/resources/whitepapers/decarbonizing-industrial-heat-2026.html): Roadmap for industrial thermal decarbonization.
- [Navigating CAQM & MoP Biomass Mandates](https://lakhdatargreenenergy.com/resources/whitepapers/navigating-caqm-mop-biomass-mandates.html): Legal compliance under Commission for Air Quality Management and Ministry of Power SAMARTH scheme.
